purpose: Teach: 仏壇/クローズアップ/パロディ/編曲/生態学/魔法使い/戯曲/ナース

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、仏壇あんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — your family has a butsudan, doesn't it?
lines.style: Quick, casual accusation with a half-smile. Leaning forward slightly. Testing to see if he'll engage or deflect. No malice — just poking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、SNSでクローズアップされて目立つよな、桜
lines.en: You're the one who gets featured on SNS all the time, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry parry, eyes steady. Slight lift at the end — turning her own question back on her. Cool exterior, but there's warmth underneath if you listen.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、有名曲のパロディ作ってんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you make parodies of famous songs, don't you?
lines.style: Pressing forward, unbothered by his dodge. Bright curiosity, like she's collecting pieces of him. Voice stays light, almost teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭の曲、編曲したんだろ?桜
lines.en: You're the one who rearranged the song for the school festival, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her rhythm now — quick counter-question, playful insistence. Shows he's been paying attention to her too. Small smile in his voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、生態学好きだよな
lines.en: Riku — you really like ecology, don't you?
lines.style: Softer now, genuine curiosity breaking through the game. Still poking, but with real interest. No performance.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、魔法使いの小説書いてんだろ?桜
lines.en: You're the one writing that wizard novel, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter, more direct. He's stopped deflecting — just stating what he knows about her. There's something like admiration in how he says it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文学の授業で戯曲やったろ?
lines.en: Riku — didn't you do a play in your literature class?
lines.style: Voice softens further. She's moved past the teasing now — genuinely interested in the real things he does. Leaning in slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお母さん、ナースなんだろ?桜
lines.en: Your mom's a nurse, isn't she, Sakura?
lines.style: Close, steady voice. The question feels almost intimate now — asking about something real that matters. Eyes holding hers. No deflection left.
